theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_sc_fderivWithin_tangent_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → E) (f' : Euclid P →L[ℝ] E) (x : Euclid P), HasFDerivWithinAt f f' M x → ∀ v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x), fderivWithin ℝ f M x v = f' v
